;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**A remote-controlled mine detonates in [[Baidoa]], [[Somalia]], killing five people and injuring 10. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-07/04/c_139188359.htm (Xinhua)]
**A [[suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]]er [[detonate]]s at a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], injuring at least five people. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-blast/suicide-car-bomber-hits-checkpoint-at-somalias-mogadishu-port-idUSKCN24506D (Reuters)]
*[[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]], [[China–United States relations]]
**The [[USS Nimitz|USS ''Nimitz'']] and the [[USS Ronald Reagan|USS ''Ronald Reagan'']] participate in dual-carrier operations and exercises in the disputed [[South China Sea]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-s-sends-carriers-south-china-sea-during-chinese-military-n1232899 (Reuters via NBC)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] announces that 44 combatants have been killed in clashes between the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] and [[Syrian Army]] since Thursday. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/07/04/Over-40-fighters-killed-in-clashes-between-ISIS-regime-in-Syria-Monitor-.html (Al Arabiya)]

;Arts and culture
*[[List of monuments and memorials removed during the George Floyd protests]]
**[[Black Lives Matter]] protesters tear down the [[Statue of Christopher Columbus (Baltimore)|Statue of Christopher Columbus]] in [[Baltimore]], [[Maryland]], and throw it into the city's [[Inner Harbor]]. [[Baltimore City Council]] President [[Brandon Scott]] had previously called for the statue to be removed. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/07/05/us/baltimore-protests-christopher-columbus-statue-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the building of [[National Garden of American Heroes]] through executive order, which will consist of statues of notable American political figures, activists, businesspeople, and [[pop culture]] icons. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/watch-live-trump-to-deliver-4th-of-july-remarks-at-mount-rushmore/ (CBS News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Pub]]s and [[Barber|barbershops]] are allowed to re-open in [[England]] for the first time since March. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/pubs-england-reopen-despite-lingering-coronavirus-fears-n1232798 (NBC)]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***Donald Trump signs an extension of the [[Paycheck Protection Program]] to extend the filing deadline to August 8. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-signs-extension-covid-relief-ppp-fund-businesses-n1232908 (AP via NBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Heavy rains and mudslides occur in [[Kumamoto Prefecture]], [[Kyushu]], [[Japan]]. At least 14 residents of a nursing home in [[Kuma, Kumamoto|Kuma]] are feared dead after they are found "in cardio-respiratory arrest", according to prefecture Governor [[Ikuo Kabashima]]. Another 10 people are missing and dozens stranded on rooftops. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/heavy-rains-trigger-floods-mudslides-southern-japan-200704082235367.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A fire is reported at a [[power plant]] in the city of [[Ahvaz]], in south-western [[Iran]], while a [[chlorine]] gas leak injures 70 workers at a petrochemicals plant near [[Bandar-e Emam Khomeyni]]. The incidents come after a string of other unexplained blazes and explosions at Iranian facilities. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/04/fire-breaks-out-at-power-station-in-iran (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[Siberian tiger]] kills a [[zookeeper]] at [[Zürich Zoologischer Garten|Zürich Zoo]] in [[Zürich]], [[Switzerland]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-swiss-tiger/siberian-tiger-kills-zookeeper-in-zurich-idUKKBN2450L2?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***The [[Government of Catalonia|Catalan government]] locks down the county of [[Segrià]], with 200,000 inhabitants, due to a major outbreak, becoming the first confinement after the end of the [[state of emergency]]. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-spain-locks-down-area-22300476 (''Daily Mirror'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[President of Iran|President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] announces new measures to curb the spread of the virus, including mandatory wearing of masks in covered public areas. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/iran-imposes-new-curbs-as-coronavirus-toll-rises-idUSKBN2450DD (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 drug development]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] suspends its trials of the malaria drug [[hydroxychloroquine]] and combination of [[HIV]] drug [[lopinavir]]/[[ritonavir]] after they fail to reduce mortality in infected patients. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-who-drugs/who-halts-hydroxychloroquine-hiv-drugs-in-covid-trials-after-failure-to-reduce-death-idUSKBN2450OJ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**North Korean First Vice-Foreign Minister [[Choe Son-hui]] says her country has "no interest" in a face-to-face meeting with the [[United States]] unless the U.S. discards its "hostile" policies toward North Korea. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/korea-talks-plan-bolton-hints-october-surprise-200704094348905.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Canada–China relations]]
**The Chinese embassy in [[Ottawa]] issues a rebuke of [[Canada]], saying that it has "grossly interfered" in its affairs a day after Canada suspended its [[extradition]] treaty with [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-hongkong-canada/china-rebukes-canada-over-criticism-of-hong-kong-security-law-idUSKBN2450G9 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Phoenix, Arizona]] [[Phoenix Police Department|police]] officers threaten, shoot and kill a man inside a parked car in an incident captured on bystander video, sparking protests in the city. Police say he pointed a gun at them first. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/06/us/phoenix-police-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**[[President of Poland]] [[Andrzej Duda]] announces that he will propose a [[Constitution of Poland|constitutional]] amendment to outlaw [[LGBT adoption]] [[LGBT rights in Poland|in Poland]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/04/poland-president-plans-to-forbid-adoption-by-same-sex-couples (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*For the first time scientists at the [[Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope]] discover neutral [[hydrogen atom]]s outside of the [[Milky Way]]. [https://www.rt.com/news/493811-dark-matter-hydrogen-fast-telescope/ (RT)]
